Metadata.title: Isula
Metadata.description: Sicily as locals know it, made for you: itineraries built on your preferences and products shipped by the producers.
Metadata.tagline: Sicily as locals know it, made for you.

Home.title: Sicily as locals know it, made for you.
Home.subtitle: Tell us what you love and how much time you have: we suggest an itinerary built on your preferences, with the practical tips you only get from people who live here.
Home.eyebrow: Travel planner and produce from the island
Home.stepsTitle: Three steps, then off you go
Home.step1Text: Sea, food, history, pace, budget, whether you have a car. You can change everything at any time.
Home.step2Text: Day by day, with times, transfers and the reason for each stop. Edit it yourself or ask the assistant.
Home.step3Text: You book activities with our partners. What you tasted on the trip comes home, shipped by the producers.
Home.readyTitle: Start here, then change what you like
Home.localTitle: Signed tips, with the date they were checked
Home.localText: The details you only get by talking to people who live here. Every tip has a signature and the date it was last checked.

Affiliates.title: How affiliate links work
Affiliates.intro: Some activities have offers from our partners. Here is what happens when you open them.
Affiliates.commissionTitle: A commission, no cost to you
Affiliates.commissionText: If you book a partner's offer, the partner pays us a commission. The price you pay is the partner's price: it does not change because you came from Isula.
Affiliates.partnerText: Every offer says which partner it belongs to, on the button and in the line below: "You book on the … website". Activities and tips in the catalog are written by the editorial team: offers belong to the partners.
Affiliates.bookingTitle: You book on the partner's website
Affiliates.bookingText: The offer button opens the partner's website, where you choose the date, pay and get the confirmation. Booking terms, cancellation and support are the partner's.
Affiliates.clickText: Before opening the partner's website we record the click with a random code, which goes to the partner in the link: it tells us which pages lead to bookings and lets us receive the commission. How we handle this data is described in the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.

Cookies.title: Cookies
Cookies.text: We use technical cookies, needed for the site to work. Other cookies, for example to measure visits, only if you accept. Details are on the <cookie>Cookies</cookie> page.
